node.title: Re: html parsing
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I discussed some of the options for parsing HTML and gave some example code [id://1179336|here]: "Two classic modules are [mod://HTML::Parser] and [mod://HTML::TreeBuilder], but there are several others, such as [mod://Mojo::DOM]. If the input is always XHTML, there's [mod://XML::Twig] and many more XML-based modules."

If all you want to do is strip HTML tags, then this is a FAQ: [doc://perlfaq9#How-do-I-remove-HTML-from-a-string?]

Use [mod://HTML::Strip], or [mod://HTML::FormatText] which not only removes HTML but also attempts to do a little simple formatting of the resulting plain text.
